query: what did we decide about the recall pipeline architecture

seed_memories.content: What did we decide about the recall pipeline architecture in the engineering meeting? We decided to keep the three-channel waterfall of FTS5 BM25, HNSW vector search, and KG concept fanout, then add a learned reranker on top of the RRF or CC fusion stage.
seed_memories.summary: Recall pipeline architecture decision: keep three-channel waterfall, add learned reranker.
